title: Māgadho
text: 1. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Māgadho devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Kati lokasmiṃ pajjotā || yehi loko pakāsati || bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum āgamma || kathaṃ janemu taṃ mayan ti || || 2. Cattāro loke pajjotā || pañcam-ettha na vajjati || divā tapati ādicco || rattim ābhāti candimā || atha aggi divārattiṃ || tattha tattha pakāsati || sambuddho tapataṃ seṭṭho || esā ābhā anuttarā ti || ||
